subject: gk
question: Which of the following is a source of tax revenue?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Customs**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Customs duties **are **taxes levied** on **imported and exported goods**.
 
• They contribute significantly to **government revenue**.
 
• **Implemented** through **tariffs**, which are **specific rates** applied to the **value of goods**.
 
• Used to **protect domestic industries** by making imported goods more expensive.
 
• They regulate** trade, promote certain industries**, or **discourage imports **for various reasons.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Penalties**

 
 
• Imposed for **violating tax laws or regulations**.
 
• **Not a direct **source of **tax revenue**.
 
• Can lead to** increased government income** through fines for **non-compliance**.
 
 
 
• **Profits**
 
 
• Profits represent** income earned** by **individuals or businesses**.
 
• **Taxes are levied** on **profits **as part of the **taxation system**.
 
• **Profits** themselves are** not a direct source of tax revenue**.
 
 
 
• **Grants**
 
 
• **Grants** are **funds **provided by **governments** or **organizations** for **specific purposes**.
 
• They are** not considered a source of tax revenue**.
 
• Grants contribute to **government funding** but are **distinct from tax revenue**.
